strings.support_page_cycle_story: Vim li cas peb thiaj ua qhov no ↻
strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis tsis tu ncua rolls tawm tshiab firmwares rau players zoo li Y1 (tsom mus rau zais board revisions zoo li 6.0, 7.0, thiab 8.0) uas ntsiag to tsoo cov laus. Qhov phem tshaj, lawv lub vev xaib muab xoom ceeb toom thiab xoom nkag mus rau yav dhau los ua haujlwm firmwares kom rov qab los ntawm lub xeev bricked. Updater thiab Community Firmware project khaws cov khoom: peb khaws txhua cov khoom qub ROM, cia li txheeb xyuas koj cov kho vajtse kho dua tshiab, thiab ua kom koj cov neeg ua si khiav zoo.
strings.support_story_1_headline: Thaum cov neeg tsim khoom txav mus, cov zej zog nce.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Rescuing Broken Players: Kev kuaj xyuas kev nyab xeeb kom paub tseeb tias qhov hloov tshiab tshiab tsis txhob ci cov khoom qub qub.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: Ua kom tiav cov khoom qub ntawm lub Hoobkas firmwares Innioasis deleted.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Cov cuab yeej flashing puv rau macOS, Linux, thiab Windows ib yam nkaus.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Tsis siv neeg board nrhiav kom tau koj ib txwm tau txais cov pob khoom zoo.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Tiv thaiv koj lub cuab yeej los ntawm cov cuab yeej cuab tam uas ntsiag to thiab kev hloov kho tshiab.
strings.support_story_2_body: Kev taug qab cov nom Innioasis software feem ntau txhais tau hais tias scouring forums rau tas sij hawm Google Drive txuas, tuag Baidu huab sib koom, thiab paub tsis meej cov ntaub ntawv zip uas tsis muaj cov cuab yeej flashing. Peb tau tsim kom muaj kev ntseeg siab, ywj pheej rub tawm network nrog SHA-256 kev ncaj ncees, cov ntawv ceeb toom hloov tshiab, thiab cov kev taw qhia ua ntu zus. Koj cov nyiaj pub dawb ncaj qha khaws cov downloads thiab hosting uas ua rau qhov no ua tau 24 teev hauv ib hnub, 365 hnub hauv ib xyoos.
strings.support_story_2_headline: Tsis tawg Google Drives. Tsis xav-ua haujlwm. Tsuas yog ua haujlwm firmware.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: ceev, ncaj qha downloads uas tsis muaj kev txwv download los yog tuag txuas.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Cov ntawv ceeb toom hloov tshiab: Tau txais kev ceeb toom lub sijhawm tshiab hauv zej zog tso tawm lossis kho qhov poob.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Kev taw qhia ib kauj ruam-los-kauj ruam Installs: Nthuav pom kev ceeb toom taug kev koj hla txhua lub pob nyem.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Lub Zej Zog Ntau Hom Lus: Ua tiav hauv lus Askiv, Suav, German, Mev, Fabkis & Nyiv.
strings.support_story_2_lead: High-speed, txheeb xyuas cov zej zog infrastructure koj tuaj yeem nyob ntawm.
strings.support_story_3_body: Tshuag Hoobkas software tsuas yog khawb qhov chaw ntawm qhov koj Y1 lossis Y2 kho vajtse ua tau. Peb lub zej zog coj Rockbox, lub teeb yuag kev cai ua haujlwm, audiophile codec playback, thiab cov ntsiab lus kev cai rau lub neej. Peb yuav lub cev kho vajtse variations tawm-ntawm-lub hnab tshos kuaj, rov qab engineer, thiab xyuas txhua qhov kev teeb tsa. Txhawb nqa Updater ncaj qha nyiaj txiag cov chav ntsuas no thiab ua kom cov kev cai firmware txhim kho.
strings.support_story_3_headline: Xauv tag nrho lub peev xwm ntawm koj tus neeg ua si Innioasis.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Audiophile playback thiab cov ntsiab lus kev cai ntsia hauv vib nas this.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Zej Zog Firmware: Kev txhim kho roj teeb, huv UI, thiab kev txhawb nqa lub suab codec niaj hnub.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Peb sim ntawm cov khoom siv lub cev tiag tiag ua ntej tso tawm ib qho kev tsim.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% pub dawb, kev ceev ntiag tug-thawj software uas tsis muaj kev tshaj tawm lossis taug qab.
strings.support_story_3_lead: Nqa Rockbox, kev cai ua haujlwm hnyav, thiab kev ywj pheej audiophile.
strings.support_story_4_body: Thaum lub tuam txhab kho vajtse txav mus rau lawv cov khoom siv tom ntej, cov qauv qub tau tso tseg. Innioasis tsis muaj kev txhawb nqa Linux, tsis muaj pob tshab hloov pauv, thiab tsis muaj txoj hauv kev yooj yim los rov qab thaum lub teeb tsa ua tsis tiav. Updater tshwm sim vim cov neeg mob siab rau yuav tsum tsis txhob muab pov tseg ib lub suab paj nruag zoo kawg nkaus. 100% ntawm kev koom tes hauv zej zog mus ncaj qha rau hauv kev ua kom cov cuab yeej no qhib rau txhua tus.

strings.support_story_4_item_2: Linux First-Class Support: Siab txhawb MediaTek flashing ntawm Linux distros.
strings.support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Cov ntaub ntawv tso tawm kom ntxaws kom koj paub tseeb tias qhov hloov pauv dab tsi.
strings.support_story_4_item_4: 100% Cov Nyiaj Pab Zej Zog: Txhua lub kas fes khaws cov ntaub ntawv qhib thiab pub dawb rau txhua tus.
